These FASTQ fixtures are handcrafted synthetic bytes generated by
`198/evidence_a/build_examples.py`. They are not retained BV-BRC service results,
sequencing measurements, or successful FastqUtils executions. The manifest in
`evidence_a/FIXTURE_MANIFEST.json` binds exact bytes and parser contexts.

The files exercise multiline sequence/quality records, explicit quality symbols,
complete zero input, plain FASTQ under a `.gz` suffix, concatenated gzip members,
and a truncated final gzip member. No quality encoding is inferred by readers.
